SpaceJoinPolicy.description: Who may join a space by themself (S10 gap G4).

oneOf.description: Any active non-guest member may join.
Members join only when someone adds them (the default).

default_channel_ids.description:
New default channels (Hearth HC6): 0–10 distinct public, unarchived channels of the
space; `[]` clears them.

items.description: A Sew id: a decimal string of a 64-bit time-sortable id (1 to 9223372036854775807).

description.description: Set or clear the description (Hearth HC4; ≤ 300 characters; a blank one clears).

rules_channel_id.description:
Set or clear the rules channel (Hearth HC4): a public, unarchived text or announcement
channel of the space.

welcome_channel_id.description: Set or clear the welcome channel (Hearth HC4), with the rules channel's rules.
